label: Huawei 5G CPE Win outdoor 5G CPE (H312-371)
description: Outdoor 5G CPE (H312-371) on the Balong 5000, 5G sub-6 NSA/SA rated 1.65 Gbps down / 250 Mbps up with 4G fallback. Its whole wired side is one Gigabit Ethernet port, which also carries the passive PoE feed, so no Wi-Fi radio is declared and the 5G uplink is carried as wan5g.
